data/historical/signal_ensemble_v1_gspc..source: Yahoo Finance chart API v8 (query1.finance.yahoo.com), interval=1d, events=history
data/historical/signal_ensemble_v1_gspc..notes: S&P 500 price index (no dividends). Timestamps converted to America/New_York dates; rows after 1999-12-31 dropped; OHLC as returned (float repr). Yahoo's opens are placeholders in old years: O=H=L=C on every bar 1950-1961; from 1962 the open frequently equals the previous close. signal_ensemble_v1 fills every G8 trade at the previous close (see PREREGISTRATION.md).
